title: Time-Varying Quantile VAR Models: Estimation and Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.36634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study time-varying quantile VAR models in which the conditional quantile does not propagate linearly through the recursion, and develop a toolkit for impulse response analysis, which to the best of our knowledge has not been established elsewhere. For example, we establish Bahadur representation for quantile VAR regression, infer model parameters via smoothed check function, and define and investigate the best linear projection of the time-varying tau-quantile impulse response via local projections. An application to U.S. industrial production growth and credit spreads from 1919-2025 uncovers structural shifts in tail relationships, demonstrating downside asymmetry diminishes at longer forecast horizons.

translated_title: 时变分位数向量自回归模型：估计与推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究了时变分位数向量自回归（VAR）模型，其中条件分位数在递归过程中并非线性传播，并开发了一套脉冲响应分析工具，据我们所知，这套工具在其他文献中尚未被建立。例如，我们建立了分位数VAR回归的Bahadur表示，通过平滑检查函数推断模型参数，并通过局部投影定义和研究了时变τ分位数脉冲响应的最优线性投影。将该模型应用于1919年至2025年美国工业生产增长与信用利差数据，揭示了尾部关系中的结构性变化，表明下行不对称性在更长的预测期上会逐渐减弱。
tldr: 本文针对条件分位数非线性传播的时变分位数VAR模型，首次建立了包括Bahadur表示、参数推断和时变分位数脉冲响应最优线性投影在内的完整估计与推断框架，并应用于美国百年宏观金融数据揭示尾部风险关系的结构性变化。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the first comprehensive estimation and inference toolkit for time-varying quantile VAR models with non-linearly propagating conditional quantiles, including Bahadur representations and impulse response analysis, uncovering structural shifts in tail relationships from a century of U.S. macro-financial data.
